variant_decisions.evidence: Ketiv וידעו and qere וְיֹדְעָיו differ only in the orthography of the 3ms suffix on the plural participle (defective ו- vs. plene יו-); both read 'those who know him'. ASV 'they that know him' renders that sense with no italicized supply and cannot separate the spellings. The only note is alternative_rendering (a different construal of the whole verse) and does not decide a reading. Base qere fallback retained.
